findings.statement: The filing lists a limited number and geographic concentration of suppliers, foundries, contract manufacturers, assembly and test providers and memory manufacturers as a risk to its business.
findings.rationale: The risk factor states directly that the number of suppliers is limited, which matches the claim.

quotes.text: •limited number and geographic concentration of global suppliers, foundries, contract manufacturers, assembly and test providers and memory manufacturers;

findings.statement: The company relies on foundries to make its wafers and does not assemble, test or package its own products, using independent subcontractors instead.
findings.rationale: Manufacturing is fully outsourced, which establishes dependence on third parties. The passage does not by itself say how few those third parties are.

quotes.text: We depend on foundries to manufacture our semiconductor wafers using their fabrication equipment and techniques. We do not assemble, test, or package our products, but instead contract with independent subcontractors.

findings.statement: The company says it has expanded its supplier relationships to build redundancy and resilience, which partly offsets the idea of reliance on a narrow set of suppliers.
findings.rationale: Broadening the supplier base cuts against pure concentration, but the filing still names a handful of foundries and says supply is mainly concentrated in one region, so the challenge is partial.

quotes.text: We have expanded our supplier relationships to build redundancy and resilience in our operations to provide long-term manufacturing capacity aligned with growing customer demand.

response.rationale: The risk factors state that the number of suppliers is limited and that manufacturing is fully outsourced, so the claim is supported. The business description points to efforts to diversify, which tempers it somewhat.
unknowns: How much of wafer or packaging supply comes from any single supplier is not stated in these passages.
How far the stated expansion of supplier relationships has reduced concentration is not quantified.
Whether alternative suppliers could be qualified quickly is not covered beyond a general mention of delays.
